# 2530. Maximal Score After Applying K Operations

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(k)), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def maxKelements(self, nums, k):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :type k: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        q = [-x for x in nums]
        heapq.heapify(q)
        ans = 0
        for _ in range(k):
            x = heapq.heappop(q)
            ans -= x
            heapq.heappush(q, -((-x + 2) // 3))
        return ans
```
